FreshNoticeState.text: Crossing tricks and repair clay were stored below the western ruin. The well and the kitchen's batch pan each need 2 measures of fire clay or prepared lining clay, in any mix. Keep what you find for the work that suits your next trip. The kitchen southeast offers one-action healing and bleed treatment in a wrapped field meal, while separate ingredients heal more in total. Its public oven and cot need no repair. Sill lies west, the alembic north, the forge east, and Marrowstye south of the kitchen. Inspect each place for its current condition.

LegacyReadBefore.stored: Fire clay seals this well's fired lining. A sound lining allows drinking and vessel filling; repairing a split takes two measures of fire clay. The old supply cellar in the western ruin stored repair clay. The reed basin nearby holds only a few drinks; it cannot refill this well.
